title: Sherry Wilson’s Shark Attack
text: In Hawaii, a shark bit off the right arm of a 23-year-old surfer while she was on her board in clear water. Sherry Wilson lost her right arm just below the shoulder. Daniel Wilson said his daughter was resting in hospital.
